subject: QB1 resolution (Tua vs. Penix)
current_answer: Tua is the de facto leader on reps and started the preseason opener; Stefanski has not named a Week 1 starter. Penix (Nov 2025 ACL) is limited to individual/7-on-7 work and has not reached 11-on-11.
next_test: Watch for Penix 11-on-11 clearance and a named Week 1 starter through joint practices and the preseason slate.

subject: Bijan vs. Brian Robinson goal-line split
current_answer: Plan is complementary: Bijan is the bell-cow and passing-down back; Brian Robinson Jr. handles short-yardage and goal line. No fixed touch shares announced.
next_test: Chart inside-the-5 carries and two-minute usage in preseason and Weeks 1-3.

subject: Kyle Pitts route and alignment usage
current_answer: Stefanski publicly emphasizes multi-alignment use (in-line, slot, backfield, wide); route rate and red-zone target share not yet established in camp.
next_test: Capture route participation and in-line vs slot alignment in preseason games.

subject: WR2/WR3 hierarchy and Branch's offensive role
current_answer: London is the clear WR1. Dotson and Zaccheaus lead the flexible WR2/3 competition; Branch's early flashes are mostly non-padded 7-on-7, and the team frames his 2026 offensive role as developmental behind return value.
next_test: Weight preseason offensive snaps; confirm whether Branch earns first-team route reps.

subject: Right tackle stability (Jawaan Taylor)
current_answer: Taylor is off active/PUP and projected to start, but RT is a flagged concern with Jerrell as the alternative.
next_test: Confirm Taylor's first-team RT reps and pass protection in preseason.

subject: Edge rush without James Pearce (Weeks 1-8)
current_answer: Pearce is suspended the first eight games; the early rotation leans on Cameron Thomas, Ojulari, Ebukam, and Dorlus.
next_test: Track preseason pass-rush production and the Week 1-8 pressure rate.

subject: Divine Deablo green-dot and LB snaps
current_answer: Deablo is reported as the defensive signal-caller (green dot); the surrounding linebacker order (Harris, Perkins, Daniels, Tindall) is still competing.
